facts.text: Quboid Arctic Ice Qube Cell Technology Mattress
Selected variant: Single / 72 x 35 (183 cm x 89 cm) / 8 (20.3 cm); SKU QUBCF720035000800CRM.

Qube Cell Technology uses a unique cube-like foam structure that combines high-density and high-resilient foam, offering both luxurious comfort and precise body support, while maximizing airflow for a cooler sleep.
The 3 Zone Copper Infused NRG Layer de-stresses your muscles.
The product comes with a 10 Years of conditional warranty.
